description: REQUIRES prior si4n__session__login call with same account_link_id. Read-only. Breaks one notice month into its parts - headcount, monthly premium, noticed premium, late fee, subsidies and retroactive premium - so an increase can be traced to its cause. Per-person detail and spreadsheet export are not offered.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

insurance_type.description: One insurance, or all for the combined breakdown.
